      "content": "from datetime import datetime\nfrom sqlalchemy import Column, Integer, String, Date, DateTime, ForeignKey, CheckConstraint, Index\nfrom sqlalchemy.ext.declarative import declarative_base\n\nBase = declarative_base()\n\nclass User(Base):\n    __tablename__ = \"users\"\n\n    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True, index=True)\n    username = Column(String, unique=True, nullable=False)\n    full_name = Column(String)\n    email = Column(String, unique=True)\n    phone = Column(String)\n    created_at = Column(DateTime, default=datetime.utcnow)\n    updated_at = Column(DateTime, default=datetime.utcnow, onupdate=datetime.utcnow)\n\n\nclass Animal(Base):\n    __tablename__ = \"animals\"\n\n    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True, index=True)\n    name = Column(String, nullable=False)\n    species = Column(String, nullable=False)\n    breed = Column(String)\n    birth_date = Column(Date)\n    gender = Column(String, CheckConstraint(\"gender IN ('Male','Female','Unknown')\"))\n    intake_date = Column(Date)\n    status = Column(String, default=\"Available\", CheckConstraint(\"status IN ('Available','Adopted','Foster','Medical Hold','Deceased')\"))\n    created_at = Column(DateTime, default=datetime.utcnow)\n    updated_at = Column(DateTime, default=datetime.utcnow, onupdate=datetime.utcnow)\n\n\nclass Veterinarian(Base):\n    __tablename__ = \"veterinarians\"\n\n    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True, index=True)\n    name = Column(String, nullable=False)\n    license_number = Column(String, unique=True)\n    clinic_name = Column(String)\n    phone = Column(String)\n    email = Column(String)\n    created_at = Column(DateTime, default=datetime.utcnow)\n    updated_at = Column(DateTime, default=datetime.utcnow, onupdate=datetime.utcnow)\n\n\nclass MedicalEvent(Base):\n    __tablename__ = \"medical_events\"\n\n    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True, index=True)\n    animal_id = Column(Integer, ForeignKey(\"animals.id\", ondelete=\"CASCADE\"), nullable=False)\n    event_type = Column(String, nullable=False, CheckConstraint(\"event_type IN ('Spay/Neuter','Vaccination','Checkup','Dental','Surgery','Injury','Illness','Other')\"))\n    event_date = Column(Date, nullable=False)\n    description = Column(String)\n    veterinarian_id = Column(Integer, ForeignKey(\"veterinarians.id\", ondelete=\"SET NULL\"))\n    created_at = Column(DateTime, default=datetime.utcnow)\n    updated_at = Column(DateTime, default=datetime.utcnow, onupdate=datetime.utcnow)\n\n\nclass Vaccination(Base):\n    __tablename__ = \"vaccinations\"\n\n    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True, index=True)\n    animal_id = Column(Integer, ForeignKey(\"animals.id\", ondelete=\"CASCADE\"), nullable=False)\n    vaccine_type = Column(String, nullable=False)\n    vaccination_date = Column(Date, nullable=False)\n    next_due_date = Column(Date)\n    status = Column(String, default=\"Completed\", CheckConstraint(\"status IN ('Completed','Pending','Overdue','Missed')\"))\n    veterinarian_id = Column(Integer, ForeignKey(\"veterinarians.id\", ondelete=\"SET NULL\"))\n    medical_event_id = Column(Integer, ForeignKey(\"medical_events.id\", ondelete=\"SET NULL\"))\n    created_at = Column(DateTime, default=datetime.utcnow)\n    updated_at = Column(DateTime, default=datetime.utcnow, onupdate=datetime.utcnow)"
